name: worktree-runtime-manager
description: Local-first runtime and safety manager for Git worktrees on macOS: per-worktree tasks, environments, ports, process supervision, and safe removal.

scripts.test:perf: WTM_PERFORMANCE_SUITE=1 bun test packages/core/src/state/__tests__/workspace-scale.test.ts packages/daemon/src/__tests__/idle-daemon.test.ts packages/daemon/src/__tests__/source-edit-storm.test.ts packages/daemon/src/__tests__/watcher.test.ts scripts/__tests__/performance-report.test.ts --timeout 45000 && node --import tsx scripts/performance-report.ts
scripts.release:verify: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run binary:verify && bun run test --timeout 60000 && bun run test:e2e && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run package:verify && bun run release:artifacts
scripts.binary:verify: bun run build:binary && bun test scripts/__tests__/sea-smoke.test.ts --timeout 60000
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --project packages/protocol/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/testkit/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/adapters/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/cli/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/daemon/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: bun build packages/protocol/src/index.ts --outdir dist/protocol --target node && bun build packages/core/src/index.ts --outdir dist/core --target node --external better-sqlite3 && bun build packages/adapters/src/index.ts --outdir dist/adapters --target node && bun build packages/cli/src/index.ts packages/cli/src/bin.ts --outdir dist/cli --target node --external better-sqlite3 && bun build packages/daemon/src/index.ts --outdir dist/daemon --target node --external better-sqlite3 && mkdir -p dist/core/migrations dist/cli/migrations dist/daemon/migrations dist/cli/skills/wtm && cp packages/core/src/state/migrations/*.sql dist/core/migrations/ && cp packages/core/src/state/migrations/*.sql dist/cli/migrations/ && cp packages/core/src/state/migrations/*.sql dist/daemon/migrations/ && cp skills/wtm/SKILL.md dist/cli/skills/wtm/SKILL.md
